question: How many recitations of the six-syllable mantra should the wise practitioner perform?
premises: The wise practitioner performs mantra recitation.
The mantra is the six-syllable one.
The prescribed count is one hundred and eight.
inference: The wise practitioner should recite the six-syllable mantra one hundred and eight times.
plain_english: The wise one should perform one hundred and eight recitations of the six-syllable mantra.
